name: Chipotle Cilantro Lime Rice
desc: The copycat rice: basmati with bay, lime and lemon folded through

ingredients.raw: 2 cups basmati rice (unrinsed), or any long-grain white rice (rinsed)
ingredients.item: basmati rice (unrinsed), or any long-grain white rice (rinsed)

ingredients.raw: 1 teaspoon olive oil or rice bran oil (optional)
ingredients.item: olive oil or rice bran oil (optional)

steps: Stovetop (Basmati, “pasta method”): Bring 8 cups water to a boil. Add rice, bay leaf, optional oil, and salt to taste. Boil uncovered 10-12 minutes. Remove bay leaf; drain in a fine strainer and rinse with hot water. Transfer to a bowl; stir in cilantro, lime juice, and lemon juice. Adjust salt.

Stovetop (other long-grain, absorption): Bring 4 cups water to a boil. Add rice, bay leaf, optional oil, and salt to taste; return to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook 15 minutes. Remove bay leaf; fluff in cilantro, lime juice, and lemon juice. Adjust salt.

Rice cooker (long-grain): Add rinsed rice, water per manufacturer, bay leaf, 1 tsp salt, and optional oil. Cook per cooker instructions. Remove bay leaf; stir in cilantro, lime juice, and lemon juice. Adjust salt.
Brown rice (any method): Use the same steps as above, but cook 40 minutes (basmati on stove), 45 minutes (other long-grain on stove), or 60-70 minutes in a rice cooker (or per manufacturer).
Remove the bay leaf, fluff the rice, and fold in the cilantro, lime juice, and lemon juice.
